critical_code_review_comments: verdict_calibration.calibrate_verdict correctly snapshots confidence_score_pre_calibration BEFORE any rule fires (line 178-180 of verdict_calibration.py). Even when no rule mutates the score, the snapshot is still set, so the field is always populated for v2 verdicts — UI gating on pre !== final is the right call to avoid showing a redundant '78 → 0 → 78' breakdown.

routers/analysis.py _set_job_phase is best-effort with a try/except → progress tracking never fails the analysis. Good. Note: completed list is appended only when the previous phase wasn't 'queued' (line 377), so the queued-state never lands in completed — correct.

AnalysisProgressStepper.jsx unmounts when progress.phases is null (line 30) — relies on AnalysisReportPage's finally-block clearing progress=null on completion (verified at line 208 of AnalysisReportPage.jsx).

Phase 'calibrating' likely completes in <100ms so 2s polling may never observe it as 'active' (per agent context). Acceptable trade-off — it WILL appear in the final completed list anyway, and the UI dynamically transitions to 'done' on the next poll. Verified end-to-end.
Pre-existing iter-38 finding (queue/status latency under saturation) is OUT OF SCOPE for iter-39 and was not retested.
